name: Galway, June solstice
$comment:
Galway at the June solstice, eye at 1.6 m — a PAIR with the other galway-* world, identical in every respect but the date. Built 2026-08-24 to make docs/46 row 58 checkable in a picture: the plants now read `solar::senescence_fraction`, and the only way to see whether that reaches the screen is two shots that differ ONLY in when they are set.

Both epochs are verified fixtures from `orbit.rs`'s own solstice tests (declination +23.44 and -23.44), not dates chosen here. 53.27N is far enough north that the model predicts a real turn; the tropics barely senesce, which is why Galway rather than the equator.
